proved: For arbitrary real c>d, every natural order r, and strictly increasing real grids x,y satisfying d+x_i+y_j>0, the sign of det[Gamma(c+x_i+y_j)/Gamma(d+x_i+y_j)] is sign((-1)^(r choose 2) * product_{j=0}^{r-1} falling(c-d,j)). The empty order is included.
Every order is strict for a positive noninteger difference. For positive integer difference m, all minors through order m+1 are nonzero with sign (-1)^(r choose 2), and all larger minors vanish.
The third-order sign is sign((c-d)^2*(1-(c-d))): positive below one, zero at one, negative above one. This corrects the fixed source signature within the same theorem.
